BC_description: The `execPath` option has been removed and merged into the `nodePath` option. Using `execPath` will now result in an error. Users must use `nodePath` instead. The `nodePath` option only takes effect when the `node` option is set to `true`, and it functions independently of the `preferLocal` setting.
Adaptation_method:
Rename `execPath` to `nodePath` in all calls.

Before:
```js
await execa('node', ['file.js'], { execPath: './path/to/node' });
```

After:
```js
await execa('node', ['file.js'], { nodePath: './path/to/node' });
```
